item.text:
**7B.9 Research Note**

Verdict: **mixed, leaning negative**. AMLO did show some anti-clientelist behavior in 2024, especially around direct-benefit delivery, technocratic macro appointments, and a few visible enforcement actions against politically connected actors. But the stronger evidence points the other way: family-linked contracting allegations, patronage-sensitive welfare timing, and repeated moves that weakened transparency and neutral oversight.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Presidente López Obrador y virtual presidenta electa Sheinbaum alistan transición y reformas para continuar la 4T](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-lopez-obrador-y-virtual-presidenta-electa-sheinbaum-alistan-transicion-y-reformas-para-continuar-la-4t/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-10. AMLO publicly committed to an orderly formal transition with Sheinbaum, which is evidence against treating office as a personal asset or family fiefdom. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.8`
- [25-06-24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/25-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-25. He said he would not seek reelection and would leave office; that is direct counterevidence to personalist entrenchment. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.8`
- [Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del 26 de febrero de 2024](https://www.gob.mx/amlo/articulos/version-estenografica-conferencia-de-prensa-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador-del-26-de-febrero-de-2024) — Presidencia de México, 2024-02-26. The government said welfare payments were being delivered directly, without intermediaries or commissions, which is strong design evidence against clientelism even if it remains official self-reporting. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.5`
- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-03-15. AMLO’s government publicized and pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected company, which cuts against routine favoritism toward insiders. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.4`, `7B.7`
- [Gobierno de México mantiene demanda en Florida para recuperar 634 mdd por trama de corrupción de García Luna](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-de-mexico-mantiene-demanda-en-florida-para-recuperar-634-mdd-por-trama-de-corrupcion-de-garcia-luna/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-02-16. The administration kept asset-recovery litigation alive in a major corruption case, which is modest but real counterevidence to a pure insider-protection story. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.7`
- [Presidente alista carpeta de información para familiares de 43 normalistas de Ayotzinapa](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-alista-carpeta-de-informacion-para-familiares-de-43-normalistas-de-ayotzinapa/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-07-04. The government said it had searched 251 sites and was still working the Ayotzinapa case with families, which is limited evidence against simple closure or concealment. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.7`, `7B.8`
- [AMLO acepta represión violenta en Veracruz](https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/politica/AMLO-acepta-represion-violenta-en-Veracruz-informa-que-hay-dos-detenidos-20240716-0024.html) — El Economista, 2024-07-16. He acknowledged police violence and said two officers were detained, which is one of the clearer 2024 examples of state misconduct being admitted rather than covered up. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.7`, `7B.8`
- [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) — Human Rights Watch, 2024. HRW said AMLO and his party blocked appointments to INAI, leaving the transparency body unable to function normally and weakening access to information oversight. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.6`, `7B.7`
- [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-04. Reuters reported AMLO lambasted the INE and pushed an overhaul critics saw as a way to cement Morena’s hegemony, which is negative evidence for equal access to neutral institutions. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.8`
- [Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) — Reuters, 2024-09-15. The overhaul was enacted despite criticism that it weakened judicial independence, making it harder to police self-dealing or punish conflicts of interest. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.7`, `7B.8`
- [Mexico's next president will have to boost tax take to pay for social programs](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/mexicos-next-president-will-have-to-boost-tax-take-to-pay-for-social-programs-3467628) — Reuters, 2024-06-03. Reuters described an election-year spending binge and a surge in welfare outlays; that supports a clientelism / transactional-politics concern even if it does not prove targeted vote-buying. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.8`
- [Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) — Programas para el Bienestar, 2024-03-18. The government admitted Jan-Feb payments were advanced before the electoral blackout, which makes the timing look electorally strategic and patronage-sensitive. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.8`
- [Revelan red de negocios y tráfico de influencias en el Tren Maya orquestados por Gonzalo, hijo de AMLO](https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2024/01/10/revelan-red-de-negocios-y-trafico-de-influencias-en-el-tren-maya-orquestados-por-gonzalo-hijo-de-amlo/?outputType=amp-type) — Infobae, 2024-01-10. This investigation alleges a family-linked influence network around AMLO’s sons touching Tren Maya procurement, which is direct allegation-level evidence of nepotism / favoritism risk. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.4`
- [Sobrinos de AMLO con contratos millonarios en Pemex, Tren Maya y Dos Bocas: Latinus](https://www.xevt.com/primeraplana/sobrinos-de-amlo-con-contratos-millonarios-en-pemex-tren-maya-y-dos-bocas-latinus/308882) — XEVT / LatinUS, 2024-02-20. The report says relatives of AMLO’s sons received major contracts and that the network was tied to instructions from the presidential family, which is strong negative evidence on procurement favoritism. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.4`
- [Mexico: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-world/2024) — Freedom House, 2024. Freedom House says civil-society criticism remained possible, but the climate was hostile and the government had a poor transparency record. QIDs: `7B.9`, `7B.6`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 evidence on pardons specifically.
- Public evidence is much stronger on procurement, social-program delivery, and transparency than on clemency.
- The sharpest positive items are mostly official self-reporting or discrete enforcement actions; the sharpest negative items are independent reporting on family-linked contracting, blocked transparency, and institutional capture.
